title: Polycyclic-Fused Cytochalasins with Anti-Liver Fibrosis Activity Produced by the Endophytic Fungus Trichoderma harzianum.
authors: Zhang, Yan-Jiang; Liao, Yi-Ling; Gan, Lu; Jiang, Long; Yuan, Tao; Yin, Sheng; Tang, Gui-Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌来源的细胞松弛素类化合物的抗肝纤维化活性与机制，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A molecular networking-guided investigation of extracts from the growth medium of the endophytic fungus Trichoderma harzianum MLJ-4 resulted in the isolation of eight new polycyclic-fused cytochalasins (CYTs), triharziachalasins A-H (1-8), along with six known analogues (9-14). Their structures, including absolute configurations, were elucidated by comprehensive spectroscopic analysis, NMR calculations with DP4+ analysis, theoretical ECD simulations, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Compounds 1-3 feature a rare 5/6/5/8-fused tetracyclic system, while 4-8 possess a novel 5/6/6/7/5-fused pentacyclic scaffold. Compound 1 is the first cytochalasin analogue containing a cis-fused 5/8 ring within the 5/6/5/8 framework. All CYTs were evaluated for antiliver fibrosis activity in TGF-beta1-stimulated LX-2 cells using high-content screening assays. The most promising compound, triharziachalasin H (8), dose-dependently suppressed the expression of key fibrotic markers, including fibronectin (FN), collagen I, and alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA). Mechanism studies revealed that its antiliver fibrosis effect is mediated via inhibition of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. This work expands the structural diversity of bioactive CYTs and reveals the antiliver fibrosis activity of this novel polycyclic-fused architecture, highlighting its potential as a lead compound for antiliver fibrosis drug development.
abstract_zh: 一项基于分子网络（molecular networking）指导的研究，对内生真菌哈茨木霉（Trichoderma harzianum）MLJ-4生长培养基提取物进行考察，分离得到八个新的多环稠合细胞松弛素（cytochalasins, CYTs），即triharziachalasins A-H（1-8），以及六个已知类似物（9-14）。其结构，包括绝对构型，通过综合光谱分析、结合DP4+分析的NMR计算、理论ECD模拟以及单晶X射线衍射得以阐明。化合物1-3具有罕见的5/6/5/8稠合四环系统，而4-8则拥有新颖的5/6/6/7/5稠合五环骨架。化合物1是首个在5/6/5/8框架内含有顺式稠合5/8环的细胞松弛素类似物。所有CYTs均在TGF-β1刺激的LX-2细胞中，通过高内涵筛选实验评估了其抗肝纤维化活性。最具前景的化合物triharziachalasin H（8）剂量依赖性地抑制了关键纤维化标志物的表达，包括纤连蛋白（fibronectin, FN）、I型胶原蛋白和α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-smooth muscle actin, alpha-SMA）。机制研究表明，其抗肝纤维化作用通过抑制NF-κB信号通路介导。本研究扩展了生物活性CYTs的结构多样性，并揭示了这种新型多环稠合架构的抗肝纤维化活性，凸显其作为抗肝纤维化药物开发先导化合物的潜力。
